stage: BASE Phase15 on-policy recovery suffix aggregation dry schema
hypothesis: Phase14 previous-action manifold exit is better targeted by a temporally consistent on-policy recovery suffix than by more isolated reset states.

required_fields.physical: 31 q + 31 dq + root xyz/xyzw + world linear/angular velocity
required_fields.actor: 93D obs + exact observation previous_action + actual issued 15D action
required_fields.event: command + gait phase/contact + controller sequence clock + handoff-relative time
required_fields.controller: full stateful controller snapshot + physical/controller/snapshot SHA-256

capture_contract.truth_boundary: post-inference/pre-physics rows require applying the stored issued action for one physics interval before the next actor tick; they are not mid-event ROS replay proof

aggregation_contract.materialization: hash-bound virtual union; no Stage335 NPZ rewrite
aggregation_contract.dedup: fixed pre-registered bins over 93D obs, issued action, root z and event time; root XY/yaw invariant; full source rows retained
aggregation_contract.suffix_fraction_zero: returns before opening suffix sidecars and consumes no suffix-source RNG

f005_recovery_model.role: future single official failed-suffix collection only; not run in Phase15

fraction_zero_dry_plan.sampler_contract: per-reset source mixture; fraction=0 consumes no suffix RNG
fraction_zero_dry_plan.materialization: virtual union only; Stage335 NPZ is never rewritten

decision.next_authorized_action: at most one hash-frozen f005 official failed-suffix capture after backup approval
